title: DAMAGE NUMBERS BY WHAT THE HIT WAS
why: His words: the damage numbers should be coloured by weak spot or element. They now say what the hit was before you read them. A hit on a weak point is the colour of that weak point (the Sentry vent and the Pillbox slit orange, the optic cyan, the Warden core seam amber, the Choir dorsal spine violet), where every weak point used to share one orange. A round from a forged gun is the colour of its element (fire red, shock blue, cryo ice, acid green). A hit the armour mostly soaked, a pillager plate, the Bulwark shield or the Warden armour, is grey. A plain hit stays white, and a hit from behind on a machine stays amber as before. A weak point comes first because it ignores armour, then the element, then the armour. The colour goes across to the other window in the same word, so player 2 sees the same colours, and the DAMAGE NUMBERS row in Settings still turns them all off. Looks only: no damage moved.
now: Damage numbers are coloured by what the hit was: weak spot colour, element colour, grey for armour, white for plain.
